notes.title: Keys of Fury at Sekai Behond!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485965/77544c990b7d27b755945c127bd53d383678b5a7.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to let you know that I will be showing Keys of Fury at[/p][p][/p][p]Sekai Beyond on October 11th 2025[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://sekaibeyond.com"]https://sekaibeyond.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Sekai Behond is University of Washington's biggest Chinese anime and culture club![/p][p][/p][p]If you're in the area, stop by play the game and say hi![/p][p]
Thanks![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485965/84135ba83f6554db26ada9b0cf99b093808a9059.png"][/img][/p]
